caption: The drawing features a rectangular panel set against a plain, light beige background. The panel has a solid dark blue border. Inside the blue border, the main area of the rectangle is filled with a pattern that mimics a light brown wood grain, featuring natural-looking lines typical of wood texture. In the center of the wood-grain field, there is a symmetrical decorative motif: a red flower with six petals and a yellow center, flanked on either side by olive green and yellow-green leaves and stylized foliage. The overall composition is centralized, with the floral motif placed at the midpoint of the wood-grain rectangle and surrounded by negative space on all sides.
title: Empire Chair
